_fields: A walk is one pass through the app in a fresh browser; each {shot} step saves an image. Step types: click (css, or label = a label key, or text; scope = css to search inside), fill (css, nth, value), eval (JavaScript run in the page), waitUrl (path suffix), shot (id, title = label key of the page title, unverified = note for the manifest, fullScreen = keep the whole screen instead of cutting below the last card). Values in {braces} come from 'values' (per language) or the run: {imei}, {model}. timezones: the browser's time zone per language, which the app offers as the new system's default.

walks.note: The phone apps wrap the same web app and add a QR scanner. Their bridge object is imitated so the page shows what phone users see.
